issues: The UI flow check fails at step 61 expecting "Backup ready to share" after creating a backup. Fix the navigation to correctly push the success screen (e.g., use navigation.replace or ensure the route name is correct) and/or move the expensive backup creation off the UI thread (e.g., run createBackup in a background task) so the UI can navigate immediately. Ensure that after pressing the "Create backup" button, the "Backup ready to share" text becomes visible within the test timeout.

feedback": "All acceptance tests except the UI flow test pass, and static validation fails on the primary UI flow check. Adjust the backup creation flow and navigation so that the success screen appears as expected.")
